evidence_plan.requirement: methods used to reduce data sparsity effects

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to address data sparsity in neural machine translation (NMT) systems.

claims.text: Combining advanced methods can significantly improve NMT systems by reducing data sparsity effects.
Data augmentation methods, such as mix-source, are effective in low-resourced settings to alleviate data sparsity.
Segmenting words into sub-components allows NMT to learn translations with considerably less data, addressing data sparsity.
Word segmentation is a necessary step in processing languages with no spaces, which helps in reducing data sparsity effects.
